name: Daidouji Ikuya
source: Ikuya has been Haruka's friend since the beginning of school and are, as an infamous duo, known for their numerous shenanigans. As one of his many attempts to prove his superiority when it comes to girls he challenges Haruka to a competition whereby the winner is the first person to find a girlfriend before summer vacation begins.
